characters.name: 沈砚之
characters.design: 32-year-old thin-browed Northern Song scholar, wearing a worn sky-blue straight robe and small hair crown, with callus on his fingers. The overall tone uses desaturated cool base with warm lantern highlights, recommended half-body front view to show his facial expression in dim lantern light, fully consistent with historical realism period drama style.

characters.name: 老周
characters.design: 58-year-old Northern Song night watchman with white stubbly beard, wearing grey-brown short coat, bronze gong and small lantern hung at his waist, with steady and calm posture. Cool rainy tone with warm lantern rim light, recommended three-quarter view to show his full outfit and accessories, fits the textured historical realism style.

issues: 铜锣与小灯笼应为腰间悬挂，画面中为手持

props.name: 油纸灯笼
props.design: Traditional Northern Song oil-paper lantern made of translucent yellow paper stretched over bamboo frame, with a small tassel at the bottom, emitting warm soft glow, surface dotted with raindrop traces. Recommended close-up or medium shot to show the swaying light and texture, matches the desaturated cool base with lifted warm lantern tones.

props.name: 酒碗
props.design: Rough ceramic wine bowl commonly used in Northern Song market, with dark glaze and slight chips at the edge, containing light yellow wine, with warm lantern reflection on its wet surface. Recommended close-up shot when the two characters share the wine, fits the hazy rainy atmospheric style.

props.name: 铜锣
props.design: Aged bronze gong carried by Northern Song night watchman, with green patina on edges, hanging from a leather strap on the waist, showing dim metallic luster under lantern light. Recommended side view to show it as part of the character's outfit, consistent with historical realism style.

issues: 人物非更夫形象（应为灰衣白发老者，画面为红衣中年男子），铜锣应为腰间悬挂，画面中为手持

scenes.name: 虹桥雨夜夜市
scenes.design: Realistic Northern Song Bianjing Hongqiao night market in light drizzle, with wet flagstone slabs showing clear specular highlights, strings of glowing oil-paper lanterns hung around, dripping wooden eaves, and distant blurred Hongqiao bridge shadow. Desaturated cool base with lifted warm lantern tones, soft diffused light blending rainy twilight and lantern glow, low contrast to emphasize hazy rainy atmosphere, recommended wide shot to show the full market environment.
